full_prompt_en: A stylized graphic illustration presents five people standing in profile beside a tall mustard-yellow door against a patterned red interior wall. The background fills the upper half with muted scarlet floral ornament, leaving a broad expanse above the figures. Along the far left, the double door has inset rectangular panels, narrow ochre mouldings and two dark vertical handles near waist height. A slim golden skirting board separates the red wall from the glossy amber floor at the bottom. The five figures stand in a close horizontal line across the lower half, all facing the door on the left. Nearest the door is a short, broad older man with swept white hair, a long pointed nose and a heavy black coat, black trousers and flat dark shoes. Behind him stands a much taller, slender man with swept grey hair and a short grey-green beard. His nearly black suit has fine vertical lines, and a mustard shirt is visible at the neck and down the front. At centre-right, a dark-haired woman with a high rounded hairstyle wears a sleeveless burgundy dress with a fitted black bodice detail and narrow dark shoes. Her exposed forearm bends forward near her waist. Beside her is a shorter grey-haired woman in a yellow-green, calf-length dress densely covered with red, orange and dark floral marks, with dark reddish shoes below. At the far right, a tall white-haired man wears a black suit and white collar, his long angular profile turned left like the others. Their elongated noses, small eyes and simplified limbs have sharply drawn, caricature-like contours. Warm, fairly even interior light gives the faces flat peach and ochre planes, with restrained dark shapes defining the clothing and subtle reflections along the floor. The overall composition sets an orderly row of contrasting heights against saturated red and mustard architecture, combining decorative pattern, large dark silhouettes and dry theatrical stillness.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅风格化图形插画表现五个人物侧身站在高大的芥末黄色门旁，背后是带纹样的红色室内墙面。背景上半部铺有暗绯红色花卉装饰，人物上方留下宽阔墙面。最左侧双扇门带有内嵌长方形门板、窄赭黄色线脚，接近腰部的高度有两根深色竖向把手。细窄金黄色踢脚线将红墙与下方光亮琥珀色地板分开。五个人在下半部紧凑地横向排成一列，全都面向左侧门扇。离门最近的是一位矮壮年长男子，白发向后梳，鼻子修长突出，身穿厚重黑色外套、黑裤和低平深色鞋。后方是一位高得多的纤瘦男子，灰发向后梳，留着短灰绿色胡须；近乎黑色的西装上有细竖纹，领部和前襟露出芥末黄色衬衣。中央偏右的黑发女子梳着高高的圆拢发型，身穿无袖酒红连衣裙，贴身上衣部分有黑色细节，脚穿窄深色鞋；裸露前臂在腰旁向前弯曲。旁边较矮的灰发女子穿着及小腿的黄绿色裙子，密布红、橙及深色花纹，下方露出暗红色鞋。最右侧高个白发男子身穿黑西装，露出白领，修长而棱角分明的侧脸与其他人一样朝左。他们的长鼻、小眼和简化肢体以清晰的漫画式轮廓呈现。温暖而较均匀的室内光线将面部处理成平坦桃色与赭色色面，克制的暗块刻画衣物，地板沿下缘带有细微倒影。整体构图将高低错落的整齐队列置于饱和红色和芥末黄色室内结构前，以装饰纹样、大块深色剪影和冷幽默般的舞台静止感相结合。
style_prompt_en: The graphic illustration combines elongated geometric forms, angular contours and large flat colour fields with finely patterned surfaces. Saturated scarlet and mustard yellow dominate, balanced by blue-black masses and smaller muted peach and grey-green accents. Narrow outlines and a few decisive shadow planes describe volume with little gradual shading. Fine linear textures and decorative repetitions enrich selected areas while broad dark shapes remain visually simple. Relatively even warm illumination preserves the clarity of adjacent colours, with restrained highlights on smoother surfaces. The composition uses an orderly horizontal rhythm, varied vertical proportions and generous open space above, producing a theatrical balance of formal structure and exaggerated shape.
style_prompt_zh: 图形插画将拉长的几何形体、棱角轮廓及大面积平涂色场与精细纹样表面结合。饱和绯红与芥末黄占主导，蓝黑色块与较小的暗桃色、灰绿色点缀形成平衡。细窄轮廓和少数明确的阴影色面刻画体积，渐变塑形很少。细线纹理与装饰性重复丰富局部，大块暗形仍保持简练。较均匀的暖光维持相邻颜色的清晰度，较光滑表面仅有克制亮痕。构图以有序横向节奏、变化的竖向比例及上方宽阔留白，形成规整结构与夸张形体之间的戏剧性平衡。
theme_en: Five stylized people waiting in profile beside a mustard-yellow double door against a patterned red wall
theme_zh: 花纹红墙前，五位风格化人物侧身排在芥末黄双扇门旁
name: Pedro Almodovar
